packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once CI is green
Group low-risk dev tooling into a single PR
Keep the Convex SDK and its test harness together: convex-test 0.0.57 requires convex ^1.43.0. This rule follows the dev-tooling group so the harness cannot advance alone.
No major ever auto-merges. Majors arrive as separate PRs by default; treat next/react/convex/better-auth/tailwind majors with extra care — see docs/dependency-updates.md

The auth stack moves together. @convex-dev/better-auth pins its own nested copy of better-auth, so bumping better-auth alone upgrades nothing the adapter actually runs, and it breaks the build — dependabot PRs #74 and #77 both failed exactly this way. Never automerged: the 1.4 -> 1.6 move also needed convex/betterAuth/schema.ts reconciled by hand. See docs/claude/auth-e2e-and-upgrade-plan.md step 7.

Cap the whole peer-bound auth stack below 1.7. @convex-dev/better-auth@0.12.5 declares peer better-auth '>=1.6.11 <1.7.0', and @better-auth/passkey 1.7.x additionally requires better-auth ^1.7.5. Capping only @better-auth/passkey is NOT enough: the 2026-09-16 verification dispatch planned better-auth 1.6.33 -> 1.7.3 inside renovate/auth-stack, which no version of the adapter can satisfy, so the group would have opened a PR that cannot install. REMOVE once the adapter widens — check with `bun info @convex-dev/better-auth@latest peerDependencies`.
